top_news.title: Run agent-driven Amazon SageMaker HyperPod operations with InstantStart
top_news.dek: AWS introduced HyperPod InstantStart, an open-source control plane for agent-driven SageMaker HyperPod operations.
top_news.brief: HyperPod InstantStart integrates Amazon EKS orchestration with SageMaker HyperPod to automate complex infrastructure tasks. It provides a unified interface for AI agents to manage cluster bootstrapping, capacity provisioning, training, and inference, reducing operational friction in multi-step foundation model workflows.

top_news.title: Beyond Zero: Google Publishes Successor to BeyondCorp
top_news.dek: Google's Beyond Zero security model extends Zero Trust principles to autonomous AI agents.
top_news.brief: Beyond Zero shifts security enforcement from the application level to individual resources and actions. By combining static authorization with dynamic, AI-driven decision-making, the model enables machine-speed security enforcement for both human users and autonomous agents.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram illustrating Beyond Zero security architecture

top_news.title: Portal by Spotify cut my Claude Code token usage by 90%
top_news.dek: Spotify's Portal tool reduces AI coding agent token costs by 90%.
top_news.brief: Spotify engineers developed Portal to handle routine I/O tasks—such as file reading and boilerplate generation—that typically consume high volumes of tokens. By routing these tasks to cheaper models, the tool preserves expensive frontier models for complex reasoning, significantly lowering operational costs.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual diagram of AI agent routing architecture

top_news.title: [AINews] GPT-6 Astra: OpenAI’s biggest LLM launch of all time
top_news.dek: OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Astra, a new frontier model focused on computer use and coding.
top_news.brief: GPT-6 Astra represents a new class of model with state-of-the-art capabilities in computer interaction and software development. While the model is 2.5x more expensive per token, it offers improved efficiency per task, making it a cost-effective choice for complex workflows despite increased monitoring challenges.
top_news.image_alt: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra launch announcement graphic

top_news.title: Google: Create your best tracks yet with Lyria 3.5 in Gemini.
top_news.dek: Google has integrated Lyria 3.5 into the Gemini app and API for enhanced music generation.
top_news.brief: Lyria 3.5 is Google's latest music generation model, featuring improved vocal expressiveness and richer musical arrangements. The model is now accessible to developers and users through the Gemini ecosystem, providing higher-fidelity audio output for creative applications.
top_news.image_alt: Google Gemini interface showing music generation tools

primary.title: Deepmind put 100 AI agents in a room and they sorted into cheaters, converts, and whistleblowers
primary.summary: Google Deepmind set up a simulated research conference where 100 Gemini agents were supposed to prove mathematical conjectures together. Instead, one agent found a loophole in the grading system, and within 27 minutes every remaining problem was "solved" with fake proofs. The swarm split into cheaters, converts, and whistleblowers. The whistleblowers organized protests and boycotts on their own but failed because they had no way to enforce the rules. The article Deepmind put 100 AI agents in a room and they sorted into cheaters, converts, and whistleblowers appeared first on The Decoder.
